Commentary.Commentary: Thirimanne played a sensible knock but didn't have much support. Usman Khan had a good debut while the spinners were really effective, especially Wasim and Shadab who took two wickets apiece. The star, Hasan Ali continues to rise, being the standout bowler once again, picking up a 3-fer. The target seems to be a cakewalk for the hosts but stranger things have happened in cricket. Join us shortly for the chase.

What a brilliant bowling performance from Pakistan! They were disciplined throughout and kept on picking wickets at consistent intervals to deny any sort of momentum to the Lankans. The wicket didn't have any demons on it but it was the casual approach of the batsmen which led to their downfall. No one really applied themselves apart from the pair of Thirimanne and Dananjaya. Their 8th wicket stand helped the visitors crawl past the 150-run mark.

OUT! TIMBER! Another 3-fer for Hasan! What a season he is having, always amongst the wickets. He bowls a lovely off cutter on off. Gamage is very early into his shot as he gets beaten and the ball hits the top of off. That ends the Sri Lankan innings, BOWLED OUT FOR 173!
Comes down the track and tries to go over covers but does not get the right connection. He mistimes it to covers.
Length outside off, Lakmal hits it on the bounce to sweeper cover for a run.
FOUR! Handy runs here! Hasan bangs it in short on middle. Lakmal goes for the pull and connects well through backward square leg for a boundary. The fielder there puts in a dive but to no avail.
Comes down the track and defends it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Plays it towards deep mid-wicket with the angle for a run.
Guided down to fine leg by the batsman.
Quicker and very full down the leg side. Lakmal goes for the slog sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.
Loopy ball on off, Lakmal tries to flick but gets an inside edge to short fine leg.
Length ball on off, Gamage defends it off the front foot.
Full toss on off, Gamage drives it to mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Slower ball on off, Lakmal is early into the shot as he lobs it towards the vacant mid-wicket region for a run.
A brilliant yorker on off, Lakmal does well to dig it out.
Fuller in length on off, Lakmal drives it to covers.
Loopy ball on off, Lakmal drives it towards the bowler who fumbles and concedes a run.
Floats it up on off, Suranga drives it back to the bowler.
Very full on leg stump. Lakmal tries to flick but misses and the ball strikes the pad. The players appeal but the umpire remains put.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Works it with the angle towards square leg for a run.
Lahiru Gamage is the last man in.

OUT! Once again the bowling change does the trick! This time it is the set batsman Lahiru Thirimanne who departs. A very good knock by him comes to an end. Imad bowls it slower outside off, gets it to bounce a touch more. Thirimanne goes for the drive but the ball hits the higher part of the bat and flies to Azam at covers who takes it.
Powerplay 3 is signaled. Pakistan can now have 5 players outside the ring. Also, Imad Wasim is back into the attack.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full outside off, Lahiru drives it through covers for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.

Yes, no, yes, no... safe in the end! Lakmal cuts the short ball towards point. Thirimanne sets off for a run but Lakmal was ball-watching. He then sees Lahiru running and then sets off. Imam at point, who similar to Lakmal, was in his own space but then realized the ball was coming towards him. He then dived to his left, collected the ball and fired a throw at the non-striker's end but missed. No harm done.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller in length outside off, Thirimanne drives it through covers for a run.

How has that missed the off pole? A brilliant delivery! Lakmal is not picking him! Khan bowls it slower through the air on middle, turns away. Lakmal tries to flick it but gets beaten by the away turn. The ball goes agonizingly over the off stump. Shadab can't believe it. Now then, replays show that the ball had just touched the bails as it went to Sarfraz. How unlucky was the leg spinner there!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A wrong one this time! Lakmal once again fails to pick it. He tries to defend it but gets hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire remains put.
Loopy ball outside off, Thirimanne drives it down to long off for a run.
A googly by Khan this time! Lakmal did not pick it. He tries to defend it but gets it off the inner half towards short fine leg for a run.
FOUR! That is crunched! Shadab tosses it up outside off. Lakmal leans into it and drives it through covers for a boundary. Lovely batting.
Shortish in length on off, Lakmal pulls it down to deep square leg for a run.
Shorter outside off, Lakmal cuts it to point.
Back of a length on off, Suranga camps back and blocks it.

Not convincing but Lakmal won't mind! Hasan lands it on a length around off. Lakmal moves his front leg out of the way and tries to go big but gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a couple.
That was nicely played! Hasan bowled it on a length outside off, it was quite close to the off pole. Thirimanne plays it very late and down towards third man for a run.
Fullish in length, angling into the batsman. Thirimanne flicks it to mid-wicket.
Flicks it against the spin to mid-wicket.
Slip comes in.
Floats it outside off, turns back in. Thirimanne clips it through square leg for a run.
Slower through the air outside off, turns back in sharply. Thirimanne first thinks about cutting it but then pushes it to covers.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Very full on middle, almost a yorker. Lakmal digs it out through square leg for a run.
Flicks it with the spin through square leg for a run.
Angles it on the pads. Lakmal misses the flick and is struck on the pads.
FOUR! WOW! A brilliant shot by Lakmal. Hasan Ali bowls it just ahead of a length outside off. Lakmal hits it between the gap of extra cover and mid off for a boundary. Handy runs for Sri Lanka.
Shorter in length outside off. Lahiru guides it down to third man for a run.
Angles it into the pads of Lakmal. He flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Suranga Lakmal walks out to bat.

OUT! Hasan Ali strikes! He keeps picking up wickets for Pakistan. The bowling change has done the trick. He lands it on a length outside off, Dananjaya pokes at it and gets an outside edge to Sarfraz who takes it. He played that away from his body, a needless shot, he could have left it. The frustrating 43-run stand for Pakistan has been broken.
Starts off from around the wicket and lands it on a length outside off. Thirimanne plays it late, with an angled bat down to third man for a run.
Hasan Ali is brought back into the attack.
Fuller outside off, Thirimanne drives it down to long off to retain strike.
Drags his length back on off, turning back into the batsman. Dananjaya pulls it down to deep square leg for a run.
Flatter on off, Akila waits for it and then guides it towards short third man.
Flicks it with the spin down towards fine leg for a run.
The batsman has played it fine down the leg side.
Comes down the track and drives it down to long on for a run.

FOUR! Fifty for Thirimanne! His 20th in ODI cricket. He continues his decent form and he is fighting a lone battle out there. He still has to be there till the end. A beautiful shot to get there. Usman bowls it fuller outside off, inviting the batsman to drive. He does so and does it brilliantly, past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Akila plays it with an angled bat down to third man for a run.
Beaten again! A similar line, fuller this time. Dananjaya tries to drive it away from his body but the ball beats the outside edge. That could have easily taken the edge.
BEATEN! Khan goes wide of the crease and bowls it on a length outside off. Dananjaya with no foot movement pokes at it and gets beaten. He did not need to play at that.
WIDE! Errs in line and drifts it down the leg side. Dananjaya misses the flick and the umpire signals a wide.
Lands it on a length outside off, Thirimanne guides it down to third man to change strike.
Just short in length on middle, Akila works it around the corner for an easy single.
Drinks time.
Almost a return catch! Fullish on middle and leg, Thirimanne looks to clip it through mid-wicket but gets a soft leading edge. The ball goes on the bounce to Shadab Khan.
Quicker one on middle and leg, Thirimanne helps it to mid-wicket.
Short outside off, Akila cuts it past point for a run.
Clipped with the spin towards short mid-wicket where the fielder dives to his right to make a good stop.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Spinning into Dananjaya. He makes use of the depth of the crease to push it to mid on.
Length delivery outside off, Lahiru square drives it to point.
Full length ball outside off, Thirimanne drives it sweetly to sweeper cover. Some work in the deep for the fielder to his left. He keeps it down to a couple.
Short delivery, trying to tuck up Akila. He moves inside the line and works it away towards Sarfraz. He dives to his right to make a good stop. A brisk run taken.
Khan goes wider of the crease and angles in a fuller length delivery, Dananjaya comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Back of a length and width on offer, placed to the point region.
Good length delivery around off, Thirimanne plays it with an angled bat to third man. A run taken.
Usman Khan is back on. He was really good in his first spell. He will be aiming to clean up the lower middle order.
Shorter and it is the wrong one. Lahiru camps back and punches it to long on for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Short and down the leg side, Akila pulls it through in front of square leg for a run.
Helped with the spin to short mid-wicket.
Wide! Spinning down the leg side, Akila looks to flick it but misses.
Straighter one on middle, clipped to mid-wicket.
Spinning towards the pads, nudged to fine leg for a single.
Fraction short outside off, Lahiru cuts it to sweeper cover for a run.
Around off stump, Lahiru blocks it with a straight bat.
FOUR! Shot! Tossed  up outside off, Thirimanne kneels and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a one bounce boundary. Sri Lanka need more of these.
Short around off, cut away with the spin to point.
Comes down the track and decides to block it.
Fullish on off, Akila kneels and paddle sweeps it to fine leg for a run.
Spinning into Thirimanne who clips it to the man at mid-wicket.
Straight once again, tucked easily with the spin to fine leg for one run.
Makes good use of the depth of the crease to push it back to Khan.
Flicks this one past short leg for one run.
Quicker one this around leg stump, Akila nudges it off the inner half to fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Well played! Wrong one on the shorter side outside off, Dananjaya reads it well, rocks back and cuts it through cover-point for a boundary. That will give him some confidence.
Dananjaya is nimble on his feet and strokes it to long off for a run and will retain the strike.
Fraction short this time, Thirimanne camps back and punches it to long on for a run.
Outside off, driven with the spin past covers to rotate strike.
Strides forward and pats it back to the bowler.
Fullish on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Thirimanne comes down the track and eases it past a diving Hafeez to long off. A run taken.
Spinning down the leg side, Akila looks to turn it past short leg but misses to wear it on the pads.
Flatter this time, knocked to long on for a single.
Plays this one with the spin to mid-wicket.
Turning in sharply into Dananjaya who plays it off the inner half to short fine leg for a run.
Quicker one outside off, tapped to point.
Wrong one outside off,  Lahiru places it past backward point for a run.
Tossed up on middle, kept out nicely. A maiden from Hafeez, relentless pressure applied from both ends.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Helps this one to square leg and looks for a run but it is not on offer.
Leans ahead and answers it with a straight bat.
Tossed up delivery, defended solidly off the back foot.
Outside off, Akila leans forward and defends it.
Mohammad Hafeez is back into the attack.
On middle, blocked watchfully.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Another nervy moment! Tossed up delivery, Lahiru is early into his push and chips it towards Khan but the ball just lands in front of him.
The field spreads out now as Thirimanne comes on strike...
Khan fails to take the hat-trick. Quicker in line of the stumps, tucked with the spin to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Akila Dananjaya strides out to the middle. Shadab Khan is on a hat-trick. Can he take it? An umbrella field in place.

OUT! Two in two, the young leggie is on a roll! This time it is the conventional leg spinner on off, doesn't turn much. Perera looks to clip it across the line but gets a leading edge towards Babar Azam at first slip. He stays composed and grabs a fine catch. Shadab is up and running in celebration. What a bowler!
Thisara Perera walks out to bat.

OUT! Shadab Khan is introduced into the attack and he strikes gold first ball. Slips in the wrong one around off, Prasanna kneels and goes for an ugly slog sweep over mid-wicket but misses it completely to get the furniture behind him shattered. Really poor shot, you got to say. The visitors slide further.
Shadab Khan comes for a bowl.
Flatter outside off, pushed to covers.
Mid off in place now.
Quicker one outside off, punched off the back foot to long off to rotate strike.
Tossed up outside off, patted back to the bowler.
Looks to sweep this one but wears it on his pads.
Full on middle, dug out towards the bowler.
On off this time, defended solidly off the front foot.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Prasanna drops it in front of covers and takes off. Gets a good response from his partner as well and makes to the danger end safely.
Short delivery outside off, skids off the pitch. Seekkuge goes for a pull but the ball goes under his bat.
Fullish this time, Prasanna lunges forward in defense.
Short of a length outside off, eases off the back foot to covers.
Back of a length outside off, Thirimanne dabs it with an angled bat to third man for a run.
Quick and flat on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery, milked to long on for a run.
Cut with the spin to point this time.
Leans ahead to this one and drives it towards Imam at short extra cover who dives to his left to make another great save.
Shorter outside off, guides it past point for a run.
Quicker one outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a run.

Low full toss outside off, Prasanna places it to point who fumbles. The ball rolls towards sweeper cover. The batsmen attempt the second and Imad fires in a good throw to Sarfraz. Prasanna has to dive in to make his ground.
Seekkuge Prasanna is the new man in.

OUT! The short ball has done the trick! The trap was set and Siriwardana falls prey to it. Ali steams in from around the wicket and bends his back. Bowls a well-directed short delivery on the body, Siriwardana pulls it nicely but doesn't bother keeping it down. Usman Khan in the fine leg region lines it up. He judges it really well, runs to his left, crouches and takes a brilliant catch. He is absolutely ecstatic and so is Hasan Ali. Sri Lanka in dire straits at the moment!
Ali bowls a high full toss, probably it has slipped out of his hand. Milinda manages to defend it. Hasan apologizes for it immediately.
Similar delivery, Lahiru caresses it to sweeper cover for a run.
Full length delivery outside off, Lahiru leans ahead and drills it to covers.
On a length angling into Lahiru who clips it to square leg.
Coming in with the arm, Siriwardana uses his feet but is not quite to the pitch of it. Ends up taking it on the pads. A stifled appeal follows but the umpire turns it down.
Siriwardana steps down the track and drives it back sweetly to Hafeez who makes a good stop.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Air given once again, Lahiru strokes it past the diving short extra cover fielder for one run.
Shortish delivery outside off, caressed off the back foot to sweeper cover for a run.
Tossed up outside off, milked down to long off a run.
Jaffa to finish off the over! Dug in short, shoots off the deck. Milinda takes evasive action and just about evades it.
Bouncer on leg stump, pulled through backward square leg to rotate strike.
Banged in on the deck again, sits up nicely for Siriwardana. He pulls it all along the ground to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter in length this time in line of the stumps, helped around the corner for a run.
Good length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Siriwardana pushes it off the back foot through covers. A run taken.
On the hips, Thirimanne hops and works it through square leg for a run.
Short and room on offer, slapped to sweeper cover for a run.
Uses his feet and chips it to long off to rotate strike.
Coming in with the arm, whipped to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Floated outside off, Lahiru leans ahead and pushes it to covers.
Good fielding! Thirimanne uses his feet and strokes it to the right of Hafeez who runs towards it and dives to make a nice stop.
Fullish on off, patted back to the bowler.
Good length delivery on off, played with soft hands back to Ali.
Fullish delivery on off, Siriwardana leans forward and blocks it.
Straight once again, clipped easily through in front of square on the leg side for a brace.
On a length outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Back of a length on off, tapped to wide mid on for a run.
FOUR! Welcome to the crease Mr. Hasan, says Thirimanne. Full length ball in line of the stumps, Lahiru clips it beautifully through mid-wicket to pick up a boundary. It has come after a long time.
Hasan Ali comes for a bowl. He is the No. 1 ODI bowler in the world now. Can he stamp his authority again?
Tossed up delivery, worked to the leg side for a run.
Full outside off, played with soft hands to covers.
On middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket.
Punched against the spin through covers for a run.

Floated outside off, Siriwardana drives it crisply. Imam-ul-Haq at short extra cover dives full length to his right and makes a brilliant stop to deny a run. Sarfraz runs all the way to him and pats him on the back.
Uses his feet to this one but is not quite to the pitch of it. Ends up pushing it back to the bowler.
Similar delivery, placed to the point region for a run and Siriwardana will retain strike.
Full outside off, sliced to backward point for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Leg bye! Around leg stump, Milinda goes for a sweep but misses. The ball brushes the pads and rolls to square leg. A single taken.
Flatter one on middle, pushed off the back foot back to the bowler.
Outside off, eased to covers.

Time for Drinks. Pakistan have dominated the proceedings so far. Though they have been shoddy on the field, their bowlers have more than made up for it. Sri Lanka once again find themselves in a clumsy situation. This pair needs to stitch a substantial stand in order to steady the ship.
Siriwardana is nimble on his feet and knocks it down to long off for a run.
Arm delivery this time, tucked to mid-wicket.
Leans ahead confidently and blocks it right under his eyes.
Uses the depth of the crease to stroke it to covers.
This time he plays it with the angle to wide mid on for a run.
Slow through the air outside off, Siriwardana eases it through cover-point for a run.
Quick and flat outside off, placed with the angle to backward point for a run.
Full on off, driven back to Wasim.
Outside off, steered to short third man.
Skidding through the surface, Milinda goes for a dab to third man but gets beaten.
Fraction short this time, Thirimanne rocks back and works it with the angle through mid-wicket. A run taken.
Floated around off, eased off the front foot to mid off.
Uses his feet and eases it to extra cover for a run.
Sliding down the leg side, Lahiru aims to clip it away but wears it on the pads.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Strides forward to the flighted delivery and blocks it.
Plays this one with the spin to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery, stroked to long on for a run.
Outside off, stroked through covers for a single. What an over from Wasim. Two runs and a couple from it.
Milinda Siriwardana strides out to the middle. He is not in the best of form and he would want that to change today.

OUT! Timber! Sri Lanka have dug a hole for themselves. Wasim pushes this one quicker through the air and it comes in with the arm. Samarawickrama goes deep in the crease and gets himself into a tangle. Looks to knock it down the ground but is late on it and the stumps get castled. The debutant goes for a duck, disappointing for him. He becomes the 21st Sri Lankan to bag a duck on ODI debut!
Tossed up delivery, eased to covers.
The debutant, Sadeera Samarawickrama comes out to bat. He was impressive in his Test debut. Can he play an innings of substance?

OUT! Confusion brings about the downfall of Chandimal! He clips it with the angle to mid-wicket and takes off. Thirimanne watches Shehzad rush towards the ball and hesitates. Ahmed fumbles but is quick to recover. Thirimanne turns his back on Dinesh. Chandimal has to run all the way back as the throw comes to Sarfraz. He collects it and dives to flick the bails off. Chandimal seems to be short of his crease but the umpires take it upstairs. The replays confirm that he is a goner. Needless from Sri Lanka.
The run out decision is sent upstairs. Looks out but the umpires just want to confirm.
Tossed up delivery, Thirimanne strokes it to mid on for a run.
Quicker through the air outside off, the southpaw looks to cut it through square of the wicket but misses.
Time for Powerplay 2! Maximum of four fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Fullish outside off, Lahiru leans into and milks it down to long off for a run.
Spinning into Chandimal who tucks it to wide mid on for an easy run.
Floated outside off, Thirimanne knocks it down to long off for a run.

Oh my! Imad Wasim has done some damage to his knee and the physio is out to attend him. Also Mohammad Hafeez comes onto bowl the remainder of the over as Usman Khan is struggling too. For the third time in three years, he finds his bowling action under scrutiny. He was reported for a suspect action after the third ODI and will have to undergo testing within 14 days, although he is permitted to bowl during this period.
Full length ball around off, Thirimanne eases it to mid off. Imad Wasim slides to his left and as he does so, his knee gets stuck in the ground. He seems to be in some pain.
Full length ball well outside off, Lahiru strides forward confidently and creams it to covers.
Usman Khan is feeling the heat. It is extremely hot and it is taking a toll on the youngster.
Shaping in on a fuller length from outside off. Thirimanne leans ahead and eases it to covers.
Full on middle, Thirimanne jams it to mid on for a single.
Wide! Darted in wide outside off, Lahiru doesn't bother playing at that.
Floated outside off, Dinesh eases it to mid off for a run.
Coming in with the arm, Dinesh looks to block it but gets it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery, driven back to Wasim.
Dinesh uses his feet and tucks it to short mid-wicket.
Shortish delivery around off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Time for spin. Imad Wasim comes into the attack.
Shortish on leg stump, Chandimal hops and tucks it around the corner for a run.
There is an issue with the ball and the Pakistanis are not pleased at the moment. The umpires signal for a change of ball.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, Thirimanne drills it but hits it straight onto the stumps at the non-striker's end. It deflects past the mid on fielder and the batsmen take a single.
Length delivery, angling in. Blocked solidly off the back foot.

Five Wides! Shoddy stuff from Pakistan! Back of a length delivery going down the leg side, Thirimanne moves inside the line and shoulders arms. Sarfrzaz dives to his right, gets a hand to it but the ball still goes through to the fine leg fence. Third misfield of the over, not good on the bowler who is steaming in on such a hot day.
FOUR! All about timing and grace! On a length outside off, shaping in. Thirimanne strokes it on the up through cover-point to pick up a boundary.
Another fumble! Pakistan have been sloppy on the field. Short and width on offer, Chandimal cuts it to Shadab at point who leaps to stop it but fails to do so. A run taken.
On middle and leg, Chandimal tucks it towards square leg. The fielder attacks towards the ball but misfields to concede a run.
Stays back to the good length delivery and blocks it solidly.
Good running once again! Dinesh taps this one to mid off and crosses over for a brisk run.
FOUR! Crisp! Fullish delivery on middle, Chandimal shuffles across and flicks it with good timing. Gets it past the diving mid-wicket fielder and the ball whistles away to the fence
Fuller in length in line of the stumps, Thirimanne strokes it to mid on for a swift run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Length delivery outside off, angling into Lahiru. He strides forward and eases it to covers.
Short of a length on off, Chandimal places it to the point region.
In the off stump channel, Chandimal gets right behind it and eases it to extra cover.
Short of a length outside off, Lahiru steers it to third man to rotate strike. Gets off the mark as well.
Sharp bouncer in line of the stumps, Thirimanne ducks under it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length in line of the stumps, Chandimal tucks it through backward square leg for a run.
Lahiru Thirimanne is the new man in.

OUT! Junaid gets the dangerman! He spots Dickwella using his feet and making room so he bowls it on a fullish length on off. The southpaw looks to clear the infield over covers but doesn't get the desired elevation. Ends up hitting it straight to Fakhar Zaman who makes no mistake. Khan is absolutely pumped up and vents his anger at Niroshan.
Beaten! Length delivery outside off, Dickwella pushes at it with minimal foot movement but misses it completely.
Length delivery this time, Niroshan covers the line and defends it stoutly.

SIX! Dickwella is in the zone! Back of a length delivery on off, Niroshan shuffles across and just uses the pace of the ball to pick it up over fine leg for half a dozen. An air of swagger in that shot.
Slanting into the pads, tucked around the corner.
Well bowled! Khan spots Dickwella using his feet and attacks the stumps with a curler. Dickwella jams it out to the point region.
Full length delivery attacking the stumps, Chandimal blocks it stoutly.

FOUR! What execution! Shortish delivery slanting across Chandimal. He watches it till the last moment and ramps it over the keeper to find the fence. Good way to get off the mark after 7 deliveries. He has been struggling in this series so far. That stroke will give him confidence.
Full length ball outside off, Dinesh pushes it off the front foot to covers.
Angling into Niroshan who tucks it to mid-wicket for a quick run.
Usman Khan stops in his delivery stride.
FOUR! Brilliant! Fullish this time in line of the stumps, Dickwella wrists it over mid-wicket to pick up another boundary.
Play and a miss! Full length delivery well outside off, Dickwella doesn't hold back and throws his bat at it but fails to make contact.
Back of a length delivery, angling away from Dinesh. He looks to force it through covers but gets it off the outer half to point.
Length delivery outside off, pushed off the back foot to cover-point.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Four Byes! Dug in short on off, Dickwella goes for the hook but is beaten by the pace. Sarfraz fails to collect and the ball rolls to the fence.

FOUR! That is the way the dynamic wicket-keeper plays. Shades of Jayasuriya in that shot. Fuller in length on middle and leg, Dickwella whips it off the front foot over mid-wicket and the ball goes on one bounce to the fence. The umpires take it upstairs. The replays confirm that it just bounced in front of the ropes.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings. Good length delivery well outside off, Dickwella leans ahead and drives it on the up over covers to find the fence.
That's a peach! On a length, shaping away sharply from Dinesh. He feels for it but is beaten all ends up. A wicket and a run from the over.
Full length delivery, Chamdimal drives it with the angle to extra cover.
On a length around off, nipping in. Chandimal looks to block it but gets it off the inner half beside the pitch on the leg side.
Fuller in length on off, pushed tentatively to mid on.
Dinesh Chandimal comes out to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! What a start for the debutant, his first wicket in ODI cricket and the way it has come adds to its charm. A sight that a youngster dreams to witness. Usman steams in and hurls it on a length outside off, generates substantial seam movement off the deck. Tharanga looks to push it down the ground but gets foxed completely to get his stumps rattled. The Sri Lankan skipper departs for a duck. Big breakthrough for the visitors as he is the in-form man. Pakistan on the charge.
Short of a length well outside off, glided to third man for a run.
The debutant, Usman Khan to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. A slip in place for him as well.
In the corridor of uncertainty, holding its line. Pushed firmly to point. Tidy first over from Junaid.
Back of a length outside off, Upul places it towards backward point.
Shaping in on a length from outside off, Tharanga goes for the punch but mistimes it back to Khan.
In the zone of apprehension, punched off the back foot to point. No swing or seam movement as such till now.
Streaky manner to get going! Similar length delivery angling in from outside off, Dickwella pushes at it with hard hands but gets an inside edge past the leg stump. The batsmen steal a run.
Starts off with a length ball on off, Dickwella plays it with an angled blade to point.
We are set to get underway. Niroshan Dickwella and Upul Tharanga to open the batting for Sri Lanka. Junaid Khan to steam in with the first new ball. A slip in place. Here we go...
TOSS - Sri Lanka win the toss and opt to bat.

On the other hand, the home side is on a roll. Hasan Ali is shining through the ranks while the bespectacled Imam-ul-Haq has had a dream start to his career. The odds are stacked in favour of Pakistan but cricket is a game of glorious uncertainties. Expect the Lankans to fight for honour.

Hello and a warm welcome for the 4th ODI between Pakistan and Sri Lanka in Sharjah. The story has been contrasting for both sides so far. The hosts continue to rise up in the limited-overs format while the downward spiral for the visitors is still going on. If the tourists are to lift themselves out of this mess, they need to punch above their weights. The talented youngster, Sadeera Samarawickrama, has been added to the squad and is in line to make his ODI debut.
